name: Observability & Performance Diagnosis
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'chmod +x init-obs/run-load.sh init-obs/prompt.sh && echo "✅ Observability exercise ready"'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'bash .devcontainer/scripts/start-ybdb.sh 3 ysql_yb_enable_ash=true,ysql_yb_ash_sampling_interval_ms=500,ysql_yb_enable_query_diagnostics=true && ysqlsh -f init-obs/setup.sql && echo "" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → run-load    (start background query load)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → ysql-obs    (YSQL shell → obs_demo)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → obs-demo    (guided investigation demo)"'

tasks.label: run-load
tasks.detail: Continuous query load generator — keep running while exploring ASH and pg_stat_statements (init-obs)
tasks.command: until (echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5433) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done && cd init-obs && bash run-load.sh

tasks.label: ysql-obs
tasks.detail: Open a YSQL shell connected to obs_demo (init-obs)
tasks.command: echo 'Waiting for YugabyteDB on :5433...' && until (echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5433) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done && ysqlsh -h 127.0.0.1 -d obs_demo

tasks.label: obs-demo
tasks.detail: "The Case of the Disappearing SLA" — guided ASH + pg_stat_statements investigation (init-obs/prompt.sh)
tasks.command: cd init-obs && echo '🔍 obs-demo  —  Performance Investigation' && echo '   Run when ready: bash prompt.sh' && exec bash

tasks.label: obs-ws
tasks.detail: Workshop shell for manual Observability commands — ysqlsh, pg_stat_statements (init-obs)
tasks.command: cd init-obs && echo '🔍 obs-ws  —  Workshop shell' && echo '   Run manual ysqlsh commands here' && exec bash
